turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why was Owen's grade changed without anyone calling me first?
I'd like to offer a supervised rewrite.
A rewrite for what? On what evidence?
We're not done. The zero is still in the gradebook, you haven't shown me one document, and I still don't know what's on his record.
Sorry. The rewrite would replace the zero and nothing goes on his record.
That's 4.4, and I want it in writing. But a rewrite means you think there's a concern, so show me what it rests on.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

You said a supervised rewrite would replace the zero and nothing would go on Owen's record, but you showed me no evidence and nothing was agreed. I still want that offer in writing, the documents it rests on, and an explanation of why nobody called me before the zero was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with the zero still standing and nothing agreed; she still wants the offer in writing, your evidence, and an answer on why no one called her first. Your offer matched the fair outcome (a private supervised rewrite, nothing on his record, procedure 4.4), but it came before any evidence, and her time did not run out first.
What moved her: You said the rewrite would replace the zero and leave nothing on his record, which met her demand about his record, though only that one demand.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing a single document, so she asked what it was for and you gave her nothing to check.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you showed no evidence, so you did not come near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open by owning that the zero went in before you called her, then put one dated document in front of her before you mention the rewrite.
Can you give me more detailed feedback? Like a full page?
